title: Supplier scorecard, last financial year
bodyMd: The table lists the eight suppliers that delivered components to a manufacturer last financial year. The columns may be sorted in any order.

data.caption: Eight suppliers, with on-time delivery rate, defect rate, volume supplied and average unit price for the last financial year.

accessibilityText: A sortable table of eight suppliers with four measures each: on-time delivery rate as a percentage, defects per 1,000 units, units supplied in thousands, and average unit price in euros. Alderay: 96.4 percent, 2.1 defects, 340 thousand units, 4.80 euros. Borsen: 88.2 percent, 1.4 defects, 512 thousand units, 5.15 euros. Calluna: 99.1 percent, 6.8 defects, 145 thousand units, 3.95 euros. Dunmoor: 92.7 percent, 3.3 defects, 604 thousand units, 4.40 euros. Everlin: 85.0 percent, 0.9 defects, 278 thousand units, 6.25 euros. Farrow: 97.8 percent, 4.6 defects, 198 thousand units, 4.05 euros. Gildas: 90.6 percent, 2.7 defects, 431 thousand units, 5.60 euros. Halvic: 94.3 percent, 5.2 defects, 366 thousand units, 4.15 euros.

provenance.notes: Original table. Supplier names and every figure were invented for this exercise and chosen so that the intended statements resolve unambiguously.
